releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.3.0 (the final update)

- REBIRTHS: now 15 tiers, and each one costs about 70% less than before.
- SUPER REBIRTHS: the old Prestige is now 5 Super Rebirths, for players who finish every rebirth and own every unlocked axe. They keep your axe skins.
- ULTRA REBIRTH: a new 1-time rebirth on top of the Super Rebirths. Same idea one level up: resets your Super Rebirths, keeps your axe skins, and gives a permanent x2 output bonus, 5 vault tokens and 25,000 shards.
- Normal rebirths now reset your axe skins (your Default Axe and the Oblivion relic axe are kept). Super and Ultra Rebirths keep them.
- Max chickens is now 10,000 and all other upgrade caps are now 1,000.
- Saves above rebirth 15 or Super Rebirth 5 are capped to the new limits.
- The leaderboard ranks Ultra, then Super, then Rebirths.
